pages.title: Hearth and Harvest
pages.text: $(bold)Three nodes on the Homesteader road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_orchard)Orchard and Trellis$(n), ring 3: crops, trellises and farm tools.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_hearth)Hearth$(n), ring 4: pies, cakes, sweets, cheese and its kitchen furniture.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hh_cellar)Cellar$(n), ring 5: casks, kegs, jams, pickles, juices and wine.

pages.title: Vaskar's Remains
pages.text: $(bold)The dead you find in the world can always be searched.$(br2)What they carry, their old weapons, staves, crowns and keepsakes, is yours to use once you own $(l:paths/relics)Relics of the Fallen$(n), ring 4 on the Ranger road.

pages.title: Vaskar's Bestiary
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)$(l:paths/beast_lore)Beast Lore$(n), ring 4: the hides, glands, scales and lair blocks of its creatures. Kill three trolls first.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/titans)Titans$(n), ring 8: the trophies of the Deep Mother, Ember Heart, Ice Colossus, Sand Maw and Trap Crown. Kill any one of them.

pages.title: Legionary
pages.text: $(bold)Kill the Unbreakable to open $(l:paths/unbreakable)The Unbreakable$(n), ring 6 on the Ranger road, for its cudgel, gold shards and the golden chains and lanterns.

pages.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm
pages.text: $(bold)Four boss nodes on the Ranger road, each asking for one kill:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_desert)Ancient Remnant$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_deep)The Leviathan$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_fire)Ignis$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/cata_void)The Harbinger$(n), ring 12.$(br2)The other Cataclysm bosses' spoils share their node.

pages.title: Hazen N Stuff
pages.text: $(bold)Three nodes on the Magician road:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_metals)Hazen's Metals$(n), ring 9: ores, ingots and its woods.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_runes)Runes and Orbs$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/hazen_arsenal)Flamebearer's Arsenal$(n), ring 11: every weapon and armour set. Kill one of the Flamebearer's officers first.
